summary.text: Marko Liias is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate from District 21, which he has represented since 2014, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Riaz Khan (R).
He previously served in the Washington House of Representatives from 2008 to 2014 and chaired the Senate Transportation Committee in the 2023-2024 session.

paragraphs.text: Liias earned a B.S.F.S. in international politics from Georgetown University in 2003 and an M.P.A. from the University of Washington in 2017.
He has served on the Mukilteo City Council and was Student Director of the Mukilteo School Board.

He interned for U.S. Representatives Jay Inslee and Eliot Engel, and has worked as a researcher for KING-5, a freelance reporter for the Mukilteo Beacon, a general contractor, and a small business owner.
From 2003 to 2008 he was vice president of Rick Liias Construction Inc.
Liias represented House District 21-Position 2 from 2008 to 2014, when Lillian Ortiz-Self (D) succeeded him, and moved to the Senate in 2014.

In the 2023-2024 session he served on the College and Workforce Development Committee, the Joint Oregon-Washington Legislative Action Committee and the Senate Transportation Committee, which he chaired.
